process.title: Discovery call
process.text: A free 30-minute call to understand your business, your goals and what the site needs to do.

process.title: Proposal & plan
process.text: A fixed quote, a timeline and a list of pages and features, so there are no surprises later.

process.title: Design & build
process.text: I build on a private staging site and share progress every week so you can give feedback early.

process.title: Launch & handover
process.text: I move the site live, test everything and show you how to edit it, with a short video guide.

process.title: Support
process.text: 30 days of free fixes after launch, then an optional monthly care plan.

faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a: A typical business site takes 2–4 weeks. WooCommerce stores usually take 4–6 weeks, depending on the number of products and integrations.

faq.q: Will I be able to update the site myself?
faq.a: Yes. I build with the native block editor and reusable patterns, and every project ends with a walkthrough and a video guide.

faq.q: Do you work with existing websites?
faq.a: Yes. I take on fixes, redesigns, speed work and new features for existing WordPress sites.

faq.q: Do you handle hosting and domains?
faq.a: I can recommend hosting, set it up for you and move your site over. The hosting account stays in your name.
Usually 50% upfront and 50% at launch. Larger projects can be split into milestones.
